customMethods.name: checkERP
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("checkERP() called")
	self.custom.gettingData = True
	self.clearData()
	numFound = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.erp.getProductionOrders({})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	self.custom.gettingData = False
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': str(numFound) + ' new or updated Production Orders found'})
	return
